blocking_layers.blocker: The operations panel repository was deliberately not touched; no scoped page or Playwright flow exists.
The OTP and recovery purpose coordinator, account linking and MFA variations were never run.
No RevenueCat or webhook adapter writes evidence, and the access authority is still the legacy helper.
No qualification producer, no real send, and no approved commercial values.
The sixteen old binary and new backend combinations have never been run.
No scenario has been walked from a real client through the server to a visible user outcome in one run.
Account deletion across the new domains was never designed or built.
No English pass on a real device, no VoiceOver run, and the app root has not moved to the new shell.
No render worker, so no PDF or XLSX has ever been produced or compared.
No antivirus or parser sandbox and no positive DOC or XLS security fixtures.
No safe parser and no row-scale run; the equipment import target does not exist.
Only the P05 personnel and directory flows have a real native end-to-end run; every other domain has none.
The rules are enforced in the database, but no network inspection of a real install has been done.
The offline mutation queue and a second-device conflict run on real hardware are missing.
No real APNs, FCM or email provider has ever been called.
No client telemetry producer exists, so no real technical event has ever been recorded.
The support chain has no client producer and the panel has no diagnosis surface, so the operator story was never walked.
No physical device acceptance for permission, token, time zone, reboot or Focus.
Bucket policy, signed URLs and a byte-level restore of real objects are untested.
No store spike on either store; no sandbox or production purchase, offer signature or offer token has ever been exercised.
